autoDenyPatterns.description: Stateful/destructive git — the agent should not commit, push, merge, rebase, or reset. This is the user's to run — discuss it with them, or tell them what to try. Read-only git (status/log/diff/show) is fine.
Git branch delete/rename — branch changes are the user's to run.
Git remote mutation — the user manages remotes themselves.
Terraform/OpenTofu apply or destroy — infra changes are the user's to run. `terraform plan` is fine.
`just infra deploy` wraps `terraform apply` and deploys infra — this is the user's to run. `just infra plan`/`init` are fine.
